under10.q: What goes up but never comes down?
under10.hint: It's a number... that only grows with you.

under10.q: What do you throw out to use and take in when you're done?
under10.hint: You toss it overboard to keep a ship from drifting

under10.q: A time when they're green. A time when they're brown. But both of these times, cause me to frown. But just in between, for a very short while. They're perfect and yellow. And cause me to smile.
under10.hint: You want it to be ripe.

under10.q: When I’m metal or wood, I help you get home. When I'm alive, in the darkness I roam.
under10.hint: A flying mammal that hangs upside down and uses echolocation to navigate

under10.q: What is it that has four legs, one head, and a foot?
under10.hint: Four legs, one head, and a place to rest

under10.q: I have a neck but no head. I have a body but no arm. I have a bottom but no leg.
under10.hint: Has a neck, body, and bottom; holds liquid

under10.q: Hard to catch, easy to hold. Can't be seen, unless it's cold.
under10.hint: You can see it when the weather is cold

under10.q: To cross the water I'm the way, for water I'm above. I touch it not and, truth to say, I neither swim nor move.
under10.hint: Crosses water without touching it

under10.q: Flat as a leaf, round as a ring. Has two eyes, can't see a thing.
under10.hint: Round, flat, with two holes that let thread through

under10.q: No matter how little or how much you use me, you change me every month.
under10.hint: You flip a new page of it each month

under10.q: Always wax, yet always wane: I melt, succumbed to the flame. Lighting darkness, with fate unblest, I soon devolve to shapeless mess.
under10.hint: Wax that melts as it burns; wind is its enemy

under10.q: What has 13 hearts but none beat?
under10.hint: A set with thirteen of each suit

under10.q: I'm not really more than holes tied to more holes. I'm strong as good steel, though not as stiff as a pole.
under10.hint: Linked metal rings, strong as steel

under10.q: I have legs but walk not, a strong back but work not. Two good arms but reach not.
under10.hint: Furniture with legs, a back, and arms to sit on

under10.q: What's black when you get it, red when you use it, and white when you're all through with it?
under10.hint: Used for grilling; turns from black to red to white

under10.q: I have a face, yet no senses. But I don't really care, because time is of the essence.
under10.hint: Tells time; has hands and a face

under10.q: I fly, yet I have no wings. I cry, yet I have no eyes. Darkness follows me. Lower light I never see.
under10.hint: White and fluffy in the sky; brings rain

under10.q: What can you catch but not throw?
under10.hint: Not something you want to catch! Doesn't make you feel too good.

under10.q: Metal or bone I may be, many teeth I have and always bared. Yet my bite harms no one. And ladies delight in my touch.
under10.hint: Many teeth that never bite; used to tidy hair

under10.q: I am so simple that I can only point. Yet I guide men all over the world.
under10.hint: A simple device whose needle always points north

under10.q: You throw away the outside and cook the inside. Then you eat the outside and throw away the inside. What did you eat?
under10.hint: You eat the outside kernels, discard the inside cob

under10.q: The more of it there is, the less you see.
under10.hint: The more of it there is, the less you can see

under10.q: What is put on a table, cut, but never eaten?
under10.hint: Cut and dealt at a card table, but never eaten

under10.q: I dig out tiny caves and store gold and silver in them. I also build bridges of silver and make crowns of gold. They are the smallest you could imagine. Sooner or later everybody needs my help. Yet many people are afraid to let me help them.
under10.hint: Fills cavities; everyone needs them but many fear them

under10.q: You will find me with four legs, but no hair. People ride me for hours, but I don't go anywhere without needing to be tugged. Jerked or turned on, I always manage to be ready for work.
under10.hint: A four-legged work surface you sit at for hours

under10.q: A tiny bead, like fragile glass, strung along a cord of grass.
under10.hint: Tiny glass beads on the grass in the morning

under10.q: What has six faces and twenty-one eyes?
under10.hint: A cube with numbers on each of its six faces

under10.q: What wears a coat in the winter and pants in the summer?
under10.hint: Wears a coat in winter, 'pants' in summer

under10.q: Hands she has but does not hold. Teeth she has but does not bite. Feet she has but they are cold. Eyes she has but without sight.
under10.hint: A toy with hands, teeth, and feet that can't move

under10.q: I don't think or eat or slumber. Or move around or fear thunder. Just like you I look the same but I can't harm you or be your bane.
under10.hint: Looks human but can't think, eat, or fear

under10.q: What kind of nut is empty at the center and has no shell.
under10.hint: A ring-shaped pastry with a hole in the middle

under10.q: Although my cow is dead, I still beat her What a racket she makes.
under10.hint: You hit the skin to make a loud rhythm

under10.q: People are hired to get rid of me. I'm often hiding under your bed. In time I'll always return you see. Bite me and you're surely dead.
under10.hint: Tiny particles that settle on everything

under10.q: I am the third from a sparkle bright, I thrive throughout the day and night. Deep in the path of a cows white drink. I've had thousands of millions of years to think. But one of my creatures is killing me. And so the question I ask to thee, is
under10.hint: Our planet, third from the sun

under10.q: You heard me before, yet you hear me again, then I die. Until you call me again.
under10.hint: A sound that repeats itself, then dies

under10.q: A box without hinges, lock or key, yet golden treasure lies within.
under10.hint: A shell you crack to get to the golden inside

under10.q: In marble halls as white as milk, lined with a skin as soft as silk. Within a fountain crystal-clear. A golden apple doth appear. No doors there are to this stronghold, yet thieves break in and steal the gold.
under10.hint: A box without hinges; a golden treasure inside

under10.q: What has to be broken before it can be used?
under10.hint: Break it before you can cook or eat it

under10.q: I drift forever with the current down these long canals they’ve made, Tame, yet wild, I run elusive Multitasking to your aid. Before I came, the world was darker, colder, sometimes, rougher, true. But though I might make living easy, I’m good at killing people too.
under10.hint: Flows through wires, powers everything, but can shock you

under10.q: Face with a tree, skin like the sea. A great beast I am. Yet vermin frightens me.
under10.hint: The largest land animal, with a long trunk

under10.q: Two horses, swiftest traveling, harnessed in a pair, and grazing ever in places. Distant from them.
under10.hint: A pair that travels to distant places

under10.q: I make you weak at the worst of all times. I keep you safe, I keep you fine. I make your hands sweat. And your heart grow cold. I visit the weak, but seldom the bold.
under10.hint: An emotion that makes your hands sweat and heart race

under10.q: I am the outstretched fingers that seize and hold the wind. Wisdom flows from me in other hands. Upon me are sweet dreams dreamt, my merest touch brings laughter.
under10.hint: Light and soft; once used to write with

under10.q: Long and think, red within, with a nail at the end.
under10.hint: A part of your hand with a nail at the end

under10.q: As destructive as life, As healing as death; An institutioner of strife, Just as prone to bless. It is all that is good, Yet with an evil trend; As it was the beginning of things, It can also be the end.
under10.hint: Feed it and it lives; water kills it

under10.q: Feed me and I live, give me drink and I die.
under10.hint: Grows with wood, dies with water

under10.q: Give it food and it will live, give it water and it will die.
under10.hint: Always hungry; licks and burns what it touches

under10.q: I am always hungry, I must always be fed. The finger I lick will soon turn red.
under10.hint: Licks your finger and turns it red

under10.q: Screaming, soaring seeking sky. Flowers of fire flying high. Eastern art from ancient time. Name me now and solve this rhyme.
under10.hint: Shoots up and bursts into colorful bursts of light

under10.q: When they are caught, they are thrown away. When they escape, you itch all day.
under10.hint: Tiny bugs that make you itch when they escape

under10.q: A thousand colored folds stretch toward the sky. Atop a tender strand, rising from the land, until killed by maiden's hand. Perhaps a token of love, perhaps to say goodbye.
under10.hint: A plant with a stem and colorful petals

under10.q: Who spends the day at the window, goes to the table for meals. And hides at night?
under10.hint: An insect that buzzes around food and windows

under10.q: My second is performed by my first, and it is thought a thief by the marks of my whole might be caught.
under10.hint: A mark left by a foot; can expose a thief

under10.q: I bubble and laugh and spit water in your face. I am no lady, and I don't wear lace.
under10.hint: Water that bubbles, laughs, and splashes in your face

under10.q: Goes over all the hills and hollows. Bites hard, but never swallows.
under10.hint: A cold coating that covers the ground in winter

under10.q: Born of earth, but with none of its strength. Molded by flame, but with none of its power. Shaped
under10.hint: Made by melting sand; fragile and transparent

under10.q: Without a bridle, or a saddle, across a thing I ride a-straddle. And those I ride, by help of me, though almost blind, are made to see.
under10.hint: Two lenses that help you see without riding a horse

under10.q: They have not flesh, nor feathers, nor scales, nor bone. Yet they have fingers and thumbs of their own.
under10.hint: Cover your hands; have fingers and thumbs of their own

under10.q: What do you fill with empty hands?
under10.hint: You put them on your empty hands

under10.q: What I am filled, I can point the way. When I am empty. Nothing moves me. I have two skins. One without and one within.
under10.hint: Two skins, one outside and one inside; point the way

under10.q: The sun bakes them, the hand breaks them, the foot treads on them, and the mouth tastes them.
under10.hint: Small round fruit, crushed to make a drink

under10.q: The sharp slim blade, that cuts the wind.
under10.hint: Green blades that cover the ground and cut the wind

under10.q: I have one, you have one. If you remove the first letter, a bit remains. If you remove the second, bit still remains. If you remove the third, it still remains.
under10.hint: A word that still contains 'bit' after removing letters

under10.q: Grows from the ground, bushes and grass, leaves of yellow, red and brow, unruly plants, get the axe, trim the hedge back down.
under10.hint: Unruly on your head; you trim it with scissors

under10.q: What is that over the head and under the hat?
under10.hint: Grows on your head, under your hat

under10.q: How far will a blind dog walk into a forest?
under10.hint: How far into the forest can it go?

under10.q: They are many and one, they wave and they drum, Used to cover a state, they go with you everywhere.
under10.hint: You wave, drum, and use them everywhere

under10.q: What do you use to hoe a row, slay a foe, and wring with woe?
under10.hint: Used to hoe, slay, and wring tears

under10.q: Inside a burning house, this thing is best to make. And best to make it quickly, before the fire's too much to take.
under10.hint: In an emergency, this is the first thing to make

under10.q: You can tumble in it, roll in it, burn it, animal eat it. Used to cover floors, still used beyond stall doors. Freshens whatever it is placed on. Absorbs whatever is poured into it.
under10.hint: Dried grass that animals eat and absorbs spills

under10.q: A red drum which sounds without being touched, and grows silent, when it is touched.
under10.hint: A red muscle that beats without being touched

under10.q: I'm the source of all emotion, but I'm caged in a white prison.
under10.hint: A red drum in your chest that stops when you do

under10.q: If you break me, I do not stop working. If you touch me, I may be snared. If you lose me, nothing will matter.
under10.hint: Break it and it stops; lose it and nothing matters

under10.q: It cannot be seen, it weighs nothing, but when put into a barrel, it makes it lighter.
under10.hint: An empty space that makes a barrel lighter

under10.q: What can you put in a barrel to make it lighter?
under10.hint: A void you dig or drill into something

under10.q: What gets bigger the more you take away from it?
under10.hint: Grows bigger the more you take away from it

under10.q: When you stop and look, you can always see me. If you try to touch, you cannot feel me. I cannot move, but as you near me, I will move away from you.
under10.hint: The line where sky meets earth; always moves away

under10.q: What always goes to bed with his shoes on?
under10.hint: Goes to bed at night with its metal shoes on

under10.q: Two bodies have I, though both joined in one. The more still I stand, the quicker I run.
under10.hint: Two glass bulbs with sand running between them

under10.q: Lighter than what I am made of, More of me is hidden Than is seen.
under10.hint: Mostly hidden below the waterline

under10.q: Glittering points that downward thrust. Sparkling spears that never rust.
under10.hint: Icy spikes that hang from a roof, pointing down

under10.q: What goes in the water red, and comes out black?
under10.hint: A metal heated red in water, quenched black

under10.q: I can be cracked, I can be made. I can be told, I can be played.
under10.hint: Something you crack, make, tell, and play

under10.q: I turn around once. What is out will not get in. I turn around again. What is in will not get out.
under10.hint: Turns to let things in and out

under10.q: What force and strength cannot get through. I, with a gentle touch, can do. Many in the street would stand. Were I not a friend at hand.
under10.hint: Opens what force and strength cannot

under10.q: What goes through a door but never goes in. And never comes out?
under10.hint: A small opening in a door it never enters

under10.q: Of no use to one, Bliss to two. Men lie for it. The baby’s right,
under10.hint: Bliss to two; men lie for it

under10.q: I love to dance and twist and prance. I shake my tail, as away I sail. Wingless I fly into the sky.
under10.hint: A toy that dances in the wind on a string

under10.q: Iron roof, glass walls, burns and burns and never falls.
under10.hint: A portable light with a glass body and iron roof

under10.q: I am the red tongue of the earth, that buries cities.
under10.hint: Molten rock that flows from the earth

under10.q: They're up near the sky, on something very tall. Sometimes they die, only then do they fall.
under10.hint: Green parts of trees that fall in autumn

under10.q: Walk on the living, they don’t even mumble. Walk on the dead, they mutter and grumble
under10.hint: Crunch when you walk on the dead ones

under10.q: I do not breathe, but I run and jump. I do not eat, but I swim and stretch. I do not drink, but I sleep and stand. I do not think, but I grow and play. I do not see, but you see me everyday.
under10.hint: A limb you run, jump, swim, and stretch with

under10.q: What building has the most stories?
under10.hint: A building full of stories (books)

under10.q: I'm sometimes white and always wrong. I can break a heart and hurt the strong. I can build love or tear it down. I can make a smile or bring a frown.
under10.hint: Something untrue that can break a heart

under10.q: What an fill a room but takes up no space?
under10.hint: Fills a room without taking up any space

under10.q: What goes in the water black and comes out red?
under10.hint: A crustacean that's black alive and red cooked

under10.q: A dagger thrust at my own heart, dictates the way I'm swayed. Left I stand, and right I yield, to the twisting of the blade.
under10.hint: A mechanism a dagger turns to open and close

under10.q: In your fire you hear me scream, creaking and whining, yet I am dead before you lay me in your hearth.
under10.hint: A piece of wood that crackles in a fire

under10.q: I have rivers without water. Forests without trees. Mountains without rocks. Towns without houses.
under10.hint: Shows rivers, forests, and cities on paper

under10.q: Tool of thief, toy of queen. Always used to be unseen. Sign of joy, sign of sorrow. Giving all likeness borrowed.
under10.hint: Covers your face; used for disguise or parties

under10.q: Take one out and scratch my head, I am now black but once was red.
under10.hint: A stick that lights with a scratch

under10.q: You can spin, wheel and twist. But this thing can turn without moving.
under10.hint: Turns into cream when churned

under10.q: I look at you, you look at me, I raise my right, you raise your left.
under10.hint: Shows your reflection; right becomes left

under10.q: If you drop me I'm sure to crack. But give me a smile and I'll always smile back.
under10.hint: Smile at it and it smiles right back

under10.q: Look into my face and I'm everybody. Scratch my back and I'm nobody.
under10.hint: Everyone sees themselves in it; scratching ruins it

under10.q: When there is fire in me then I am still cold. When I own your true love’s face then you will not see me. To all things I give no more than I am given. In time I may have all things, and yet I can keep nothing.
under10.hint: Reflects everything you put in front of it

under10.q: A hill full, a hole full, yet you cannot catch a bowl full.
under10.hint: Thick fog you can't scoop into a bowl

under10.q: What goes further the slower it goes?
under10.hint: Goes further the slower (cheaper) it is

under10.q: At the sound of me, one may dream or stamp their feet, At the sound of me, one may laugh or sometimes weep.
under10.hint: Sounds that make you dance, laugh, or cry

under10.q: Who works when he plays and plays when he works?
under10.hint: Someone who plays instruments for a living

under10.q: I hide but my head is outside.
under10.hint: A pin with a head, partly hidden in wood

under10.q: What is it that was given to you, belongs only to you. And yet your friends use it more than you do?
under10.hint: Given to you, used more by your friends

under10.q: An iron horse with a flaxen tail. The faster the horse runs, the shorter his tail becomes.
under10.hint: A pointed metal pin with a thread-eye

under10.q: What has a single eye but cannot see?
under10.hint: Has an eye but cannot see

under10.q: What is long and slim, works in light. Has but one eye, and an awful bite?
under10.hint: Long and thin, used for sewing in the light

under10.q: A house of wood in a hidden place. Built without nails or glue. High above the earthen ground. It holds pale gems of blue.
under10.hint: A bird's home high in a tree with eggs inside

under10.q: Hold the tail, while I fish for you.
under10.hint: A mesh with a handle for catching things

under10.q: I can be written, I can be spoken, I can be exposed, I can be broken.
under10.hint: Information that can be broken or spread

under10.q: Sometimes I am loud. And viewed with distaste. Poke out my 'eye', then I'm on the front of your face.
under10.hint: A sound you can block out with a finger

under10.q: I can run but not walk. Wherever I go, thought follows close behind.
under10.hint: Runs a cold; sits between your eyes

under10.q: Two little holes in the side of a hill. Just as you come to the cherry-red mill.
under10.hint: Two little holes in a pink-red bump

under10.q: A little house full of meat, no door to go in and eat.
under10.hint: A small round food with a hard shell

under10.q: Take off my skin, I won't cry, but you will.
under10.hint: Makes you cry when you peel it

under10.q: You use a knife to slice my head. And weep beside me when I am dead.
under10.hint: Layers you slice off; you weep beside it

under10.q: Gold in a leather bag, swinging on a tree, money after honey in its time. Ills of a scurvy crew cured by the sea, reason in its season but no rhyme.
under10.hint: A citrus fruit that cures scurvy

under10.q: What asks but never answers?
under10.hint: A bird that hoots at night and never answers

under10.q: It holds most knowledge that has ever been said. But is not the brain, is not the head. To feathers and their masters, it's both bane and boonOne empty, and one full.
under10.hint: You write on it; holds most knowledge ever said

under10.q: The strangest creature you'll ever find has two eyes in front and a hundred behind.
under10.hint: A bird with a colorful fan of feathers behind it

under10.q: A house with two occupants, sometimes one, rarely three. Break the walls, eat the boarders, then throw away me.
under10.hint: A legume with two or three inside a shell

under10.q: Lovely and round, I shine with pale light, grown in the darkness, a lady's delight.
under10.hint: A round gem made inside a shell, shining pale

under10.q: I am the tool, for inspiring many. Buy me in the store, for not much more than a penny. Don't overuse me, or my usefulness will go.
under10.hint: Writes with ink; runs dry with too much use

under10.q: I usually wear a yellow coat. I usually have a dark head. I make marks wherever I go.
under10.hint: Yellow with a dark tip; leaves erasable marks

under10.q: What has a head, a tail, is brown, and has no legs?
under10.hint: A copper coin with a head and tail

under10.q: What loses its head in the morning and gets it back at night?
under10.hint: Loses its shape in the morning, regains it at night

under10.q: What makes a loud noise when changing its jacket, becomes larger but weighs less?
under10.hint: Pops into a bigger, lighter version with a loud noise

under10.q: A skin have I, more eyes than one. I can be very nice when I am done.
under10.hint: Has 'eyes' and a skin; great when baked or fried

under10.q: He has married many women but has never married.
under10.hint: Officiates weddings but is never a bride or groom

under10.q: Three little letters. A paradox to some. The worse that it is, the better it becomes.
under10.hint: A play on words; the worse it is, the better

under10.q: Different lights do make me strange, thus into different sizes I will change.
under10.hint: The dark center of the eye that changes size

under10.q: Only two backbones and thousands of ribs.
under10.hint: Two parallel steel rails with thousands of cross-ties

under10.q: Break it and it is better, immediately set and harder to break again.
under10.hint: A vinyl disc you drop the needle on

under10.q: You can see nothing else, When you look in my face, I will look you in the eye, And I will never lie.
under10.hint: Your image in a mirror or still water

under10.q: You saw me where I never was and where I could not be. And yet within that very place, my face you often see.
under10.hint: You see it but can never touch it

under10.q: What can be heard and caught but never seen?
under10.hint: A slip of the tongue; heard but not seen

under10.q: What always runs but never walks, often murmurs, never talks, has a bed but never sleeps, has a mouth but never eats?
under10.hint: Flows but doesn't walk; has a bed and a mouth

under10.q: I run through hills. I veer around mountains. I leap over rivers. And crawl through the forests. Step out your door to find me.
under10.hint: A path through hills, forests, and over rivers

under10.q: Snake coiled round and round. Snake deep below the ground. Snake that's never had a head. Snake that binds but not with dread.
under10.hint: Coiled strands of twisted fiber, strong yet unravels

under10.q: Ten men's strength, ten men's length. Ten men can't break it, yet a young boy walks off with it.
under10.hint: Strong as ten men but a boy can walk it off

under10.q: I bind it and it walks. I loose it and it stops.
under10.hint: An open shoe with straps that bind the foot

under10.q: My teeth are sharp, my back is straight, to cut things up it is my fate.
under10.hint: A blade with sharp teeth for cutting

under10.q: If you have it, you want to share it. If you share it, you don't have it.
under10.hint: Something you share and it's no longer yours

under10.q: What has a neck and no head, two arms but no hands?
under10.hint: Worn on the upper body; has a collar and sleeves

under10.q: Iron on a mammal. Mammal on your feet.
under10.hint: Covers your foot; the 'tongue' is inside

under10.q: Runs over fields and woods all day. Under the bed at night sits not alone, With long tongue hanging out, Resting at your feet until we go for a walk
under10.hint: Rests under the bed at night with a tongue sticking out

under10.q: What runs around all day. Then lies under the bed. With its tongue hanging out?
under10.hint: Lies under the bed with its 'tongue' hanging out

under10.q: In buckles or lace, they help set the pace. The farther you go, the thinner they grow.
under10.hint: Worn in pairs, wear thin the more you go

under10.q: If a man carried my burden, he would break his back. I am not rich, but leave silver in my track.
under10.hint: Slow animal with a shell on its back

under10.q: Who is he that runs without a leg. And his house on his back?
under10.hint: Carries its house on its back, runs without legs

under10.q: You use it between your head and your toes, the more it works the thinner it grows.
under10.hint: Used for washing, shrinks the more it works

under10.q: Soldiers line up spaced with pride. Two long rows lined side by side. One sole unit can decide, if the rows will unite or divide.
under10.hint: Two rows that chew and keep your mouth working

under10.q: Thirty white horses on a red hill, First they champ, Then they stamp, Then they stand still.
under10.hint: Thirty white ones on a red hill (gums)

under10.q: What is often returned, but never borrowed/
under10.hint: Something you say to show gratitude

under10.q: Used left or right, I get to travel over cobblestone or gravel. Used up, I vie for sweet success, used down, I cause men great duress.
under10.hint: The short finger on your hand, used for gestures

under10.q: Creatures of power, creatures of grade, creatures of beauty, creatures of strength. As for their lives, they set everything's pace. For all things must come to live. Under their emerald embraceEither in their life or in their death.
under10.hint: Tall plants that give shade and clean the air

under10.q: Bright as diamonds, Loud as thunder, Never still, A thing of wonder.
under10.hint: Water that cascades over a cliff, bright and loud

over10.q: Today he is there to trip you up. And he will torture you tomorrow. Yet he is also there to ease the pain, when you are lost in grief and sorrow.
over10.hint: A drink that eases pain but causes trouble

over10.q: I fly through the air on small feathered wings, seeking out life and destroying all things.
over10.hint: A feathered projectile shot from a bow

over10.q: I have many feathers to help me fly. I have a body and head, but I'm not alive. It is your strength which determines how far I go. You can hold me in your hand, but I'm never thrown.
over10.hint: Has a head and feathers, but is not alive

over10.q: My first is in blood and also in battle. My second is in acorn, oak, and apple. My third and fourth are both the same. In the center of sorrow and twice in refrain. My fifth starts eternity ending here. My last is the first of last, Oh Dear.
over10.hint: A word puzzle using letters from blood, acorn, sorrow, refrain

over10.q: A warrior amongst the flowers, he bears a thrusting sword. He uses it whenever he must, to defend his golden hoard.
over10.hint: A stinging insect that guards honey

over10.q: A slow, solemn square-dance of warriors feinting. One by one they fall, warriors fainting, thirty-two on sixty-four.
over10.hint: A game with 32 pieces on 64 squares

over10.q: What is it that given one, you’ll have either two or none?
over10.hint: Making a decision gives you two options or none

over10.q: The man who made it didn't need it. The man who bought it didn't use it. The man who used it didn't want it.
over10.hint: Made by one, bought by one, used by another who doesn't want it

over10.q: The one who makes it, sells it. The one who buys it, never uses it. The one that uses it never knows that he’s using it.
over10.hint: The maker sells it; the buyer never uses it

over10.q: Whoever makes it, tells it not. Whoever takes it, knows it not. Whoever knows it, wants it not
over10.hint: Fake money: made secretly, used unknowingly

over10.q: Five hundred begins it, five hundred ends it. Five in the middle is seen. First of all figures, the first of all letters. Take up their stations between. Join all together, and then you will bring before you the name of an eminent king.
over10.hint: A biblical king; a letter puzzle with 5s

over10.q: Some try to hide, some try to cheat. But time will show, we always will meet. Try as you might, to guess my name. I promise you'll know, when you I do claim.
over10.hint: The inevitable end that comes for everyone

over10.q: What begins and has no end? What is the ending of all that begins?
over10.hint: The ending of all that begins

over10.q: My first is in window but not in pane. My second's in road but not in lane. My third is in oval but not in round. My fourth is in hearing but not in sound. My whole is known as a sign of peace. And from noah's ark won quick release.
over10.hint: A white bird, sign of peace; a word puzzle

over10.q: A word I know, six letters it contains. Subtract just one and twelve remains.
over10.hint: Six letters; remove one and twelve remains

over10.q: This is in a realm of true and in a realm false, but you experience me as you turn and toss.
over10.hint: You experience it while sleeping, turning and tossing

over10.q: What word starts with 'E', ends with 'E', but only has one letter? It is not the letter 'E'.
over10.hint: A word starting and ending with E, containing one letter

over10.q: A hole in a pole, though I fill a hole in white. I'm used more by the day, and less by the night.
over10.hint: A hole in a white (sclera)

over10.q: What is pronounced like one letter, written with three letters. And belongs to all animals?
over10.hint: Pronounced like 'I', spelled with three letters

over10.q: It's in your hand though you can not feel it. Only you and time can reveal it.
over10.hint: Your destiny; written but not felt

over10.q: I know a word of letters three. Add two, and fewer there will be!
over10.hint: A three-letter word; add two letters and there will be less of it

over10.q: Alive without breath, As cold as death, Clad in mail never clinking, Never thirsty, ever drinking
over10.hint: Lives in water, covered in scales, never thirsty

over10.q: I march before armies, a thousand salute me. My fall can bring victory, but no one would shoot me. The wind is my lover, one-legged am I. Name me and see me at home in the sky.
over10.hint: Waves in the wind on a pole; saluted by armies

over10.q: Up on high I wave away but not a word can I say.
over10.hint: Flutters on a pole, says nothing

over10.q: I have four legs but no tail. Usually I am heard only at night.
over10.hint: A four-legged amphibian that croaks at night

over10.q: My first is in fish but no in snail. My second is in rabbit but no in tail. My third is in up but not in down. My fourth is in tiara but not in crown. My fifth is in tree you plainly see. My whole a food for you and me.
over10.hint: A word puzzle: a food you and I both eat

over10.q: My first master has four legs, my second master has two. My first I serve in life, my second I serve in death. Tough I am, yet soft beside. Against ladies cheeks I often reside.
over10.hint: A word puzzle: an animal hide used in life and death

over10.q: I drive men mad for love of me. Easily beaten, never free.
over10.hint: A precious metal, easily beaten into sheets

over10.q: So cold, damp and dark this place. To stay you would refrain, yet those who occupy this place do never complain.
over10.hint: A cold, dark resting place that never complains

over10.q: There is one word that stands the test of time and holds fast to the center of everything. Though everyone will try at least once in their life to move around this word, but in fact, unknowingly, they use it every moment of the day. Young or old, awake or in sleep, human or animal, this word stands fast. It belongs to everyone, to all living things, but no one can master it. The word is?
over10.hint: The force that pulls everything to the center

over10.q: They can be harbored, but few hold water. You can nurse them, but only by holding them against someone else. You can carry them, but not with your arms. You can bury them, but not in the earth.
over10.hint: A resentment you carry against someone else

over10.q: Two in a whole and four in a pair. And six in a trio you see. And eight's a quartet but what you must get. Is the name that fits just one of me?
over10.hint: Two in a whole, four in a pair, six in a trio

over10.q: A precious stone, as clear as diamond. Seek it out while the sun's near the horizon. Though you can walk on water with its power, try to keep it, and it'll vanish in an hour.
over10.hint: Clear, walkable on water, melts in the sun

over10.q: Power enough to smash ships and crush roofs. Yet it still must fear the sun.
over10.hint: Crushes ships and roofs, yet fears the sun

over10.q: What word has kst in the middle, in the beginning, and at the end?
over10.hint: A word with 'kst' in the middle, beginning, and end

over10.q: I cut through evil like a double edged sword, and chaos flees at my approach. Balance I single-handedly upraise, through battles fought with heart and mind, instead of with my gaze.
over10.hint: Balance, scales, and fairness; cuts through evil

over10.q: What can touch someone once and last them a life time?
over10.hint: A feeling that touches once and lasts a lifetime

over10.q: What can bring back the dead. Make us cry, make us laugh, make us young. Born in an instant yet lasts a life time?
over10.hint: Brings back the past; makes you cry, laugh, and feel young

over10.q: I'm a god. I'm a planet. I measure heat.
over10.hint: A god, a planet, and a measure of temperature

over10.q: Something wholly unreal, yet seems real to I. Think my friend, tell me where does it lie?
over10.hint: Unreal but feels real; lives in the head

over10.q: Always old, sometimes new. Never sad, sometimes blue. Never empty, sometimes full. Never pushes, always pulls.
over10.hint: Changes phases: new, full, and sometimes blue

over10.q: I am the hole in the night, the ever watchful eye. I return in a cycle, to enlighten the sky.
over10.hint: The bright circle in the night sky

over10.q: I'm white, I'm round, but not always around. Sometimes you see me, sometimes you don't.
over10.hint: White and round, sometimes visible, sometimes not

over10.q: It comes only before, it comes only after. Rises only in darkness, but rises only in light. It is always the same, but is yet always different.
over10.hint: Always the same yet always different (phases)

over10.q: Pregnant every time you see her, yet she never will give birth.
over10.hint: Pregnant every night (waxing) but never gives birth

over10.q: Scythe of darkness, Shadow’s light. Guiding eye of thirteenth sight.
over10.hint: A scythe shape in the dark sky, guiding travelers

over10.q: What has roots as nobody sees, is taller than trees. Up, up it goes, and yet never grows?
over10.hint: Tall with roots deep underground, never grows taller

over10.q: What kind of room has no windows or doors?
over10.hint: A fungus that grows in the forest; a 'room' with no doors

over10.q: What word is the same written forward, backward and upside down?
over10.hint: A word that's the same forwards, backwards, and upside down

over10.q: It is greater than God and more evil than the devil. The poor have it, the rich need it, and if you eat it you'll die.
over10.hint: The poor have it, the rich need it, eating it kills

over10.q: What does man love more than life, fear more than death or mortal strife. What the poor have, the rich require, and what contented men desire. What the miser spends, and the spendthrift saves. And all men carry to their graves.
over10.hint: Loved more than life, feared more than death

over10.q: A man went to the hardware store to buy items for his house. 1 would cost $.25. 12 would cost $.50. 122 would cost $.75. When he left the store he had spent $.75, what did he buy?
over10.hint: You are buying digits, not objects

over10.q: I am the fountain from which no one can drink. For many I am considered a necessary link. Like gold to all I am sought for, but my continued death brings wealth for all to want more.
over10.hint: A liquid that fuels engines and builds wealth

over10.q: Half-way up the hill, I see you at last, lying beneath me with your sounds and sights. A city in the twilight, dim and vast, with smoking roofs, soft bells, and gleaming lights.
over10.hint: What lies behind you, with sounds and sights

over10.q: The eight of us move forth and back. To protect our king from the foes attack.
over10.hint: Chess pieces that protect the king

over10.q: A seed am I, three letters make my name. Take away two and I still sound the same.
over10.hint: Three letters; remove two and it still sounds the same

over10.q: I am a box that holds keys without locks, yet they can unlock your soul.
over10.hint: 88 keys without locks that unlock your soul

over10.q: My first is twice in apple but not once in tart. My second is in liver but not in heart. My third is in giant and also in ghost. Whole I’m best when I am roast.
over10.hint: A word puzzle: an animal, best when roasted

over10.q: What can be swallowed, But can also swallow you?
over10.hint: An emotion that can swallow you whole

over10.q: I cannot be other than what I am, until the man who made me dies. Power and glory will fall to me finally. Only when he last closes his eyes.
over10.hint: Heir to a throne; power falls when the king dies

over10.q: I have split the one into five. I am the circle that few will spy. I am the path that breaks and gives. I am the bow no man may bend.
over10.hint: An arc of colors after rain; a bow no one can bend

over10.q: I am never quite what I appear to be. Straight-forward I seem, but it's only skin deep. For mystery most often lies beneath my simple speech. Sharpen your wits, open your eyes, look beyond my exteriors, read me backwards, forwards, upside down. Think and answer the question...
over10.hint: A puzzle you solve with your wits

over10.q: To unravel me you need a simple key, no key that was made by locksmith's hand. But a key that only I will understand.
over10.hint: A question that needs a clever, non-physical key

over10.q: It has no top or bottom, but it can hold flesh, bones, and blood all at the same time.
over10.hint: A circle that can hold flesh, bones, and blood

over10.q: What can burn the eyes, sting the mouth, yet be consumed?
over10.hint: Salty, stings the eyes, used in cooking

over10.q: I build up castles. I tear down mountains. I make some men blind. I help others to see.
over10.hint: Builds castles, erodes mountains, blinds and helps

over10.q: One by one we fall from heaven down into the depths of past, And our world is ever upturned so that yet some time we’ll last.
over10.hint: Falls from the sky; the world is made of it

over10.q: What measures out time. Until in time all is smashed to it?
over10.hint: Measures time; eventually everything crumbles to it

over10.q: I open wide and tight I shut, Sharp am I and paper-cut fingers too, so do take care, I'm good and bad, so best beware.
over10.hint: Two blades that open wide and shut tight

over10.q: By Moon or by Sun, I shall be found. Yet I am undone, if there's no light around.
over10.hint: Cast by an object in light; vanishes without light

over10.q: Each morning I appear to lie at your feet, all day I follow no matter how fast you run. Yet I nearly perish in the midday sun.
over10.hint: Follows you all day, nearly vanishes at noon

over10.q: I crawl on the earth. And rise on a pillar.
over10.hint: Crawls on the ground, rises on walls

over10.q: Only one color, but not one size. Stuck at the bottom, yet easily flies. Present in sun, but not in rain. Doing no harm, and feeling no pain.
over10.hint: One color (black), many sizes; present in sun, not rain

over10.q: Tall in the morning, short at noon, gone at night. But I'll be back soon.
over10.hint: Tall in the morning, short at noon, gone at night

over10.q: Of these things - I have two. One for me - and one for you. And when you ask about the price, I simply smile and nod twice.
over10.hint: Dividing something in two, one for each

over10.q: Weight in my belly, Trees on my back, I travel fast in my place, but feet is a feature I lack
over10.hint: A large boat with a cargo hold and masts

over10.q: Whilst I was engaged in sitting. I spied the dead carrying the living
over10.hint: The dead carrying the living (a funeral at sea)

over10.q: What five-letter word becomes shorter when you add two more letters?
over10.hint: A five-letter word that literally shrinks when you add two letters

over10.q: What is round as a dishpan, deep as a tub, and still the oceans couldn't fill it up?
over10.hint: A round container with holes that can't be filled

over10.q: What is so fragile that saying its name breaks it?
over10.hint: Saying its name breaks it

over10.q: My first is in some but not in all. My second is into but not in tall. My third in little but no in big. My fourth in port but not in pig. My whole is made in nature's way. For clothing, rugs used every day.
over10.hint: A word puzzle: a fine natural fabric

over10.q: A beggar's brother went out to sea and drowned. But the man who drowned had no brother. Who was the beggar to the man who drowned?
over10.hint: The drowned man was her brother, not his

over10.q: Double my number, I'm less than a score. Half of my number is less than four. Add one to my double when bakers are near. Days of the week are still greater, I fear.
over10.hint: Double is less than a score; half is less than four

over10.q: I am whole but incomplete. I have no eyes, yet I see. You can see, and see right through me. My largest part is one fourth of what I once was.
over10.hint: The framework of bones inside the body

over10.q: Twigs and spheres and poles and plates. Join and bind to reason make.
over10.hint: Bones joined together to form the body

over10.q: When liquid splashes me, none seeps through. When I am moved a lot, liquid I spew. When I am hit, color I change. And color, I come in quite a range. What I cover is very complex, and I am very easy to flex.
over10.hint: The outer layer of the body; stretches and changes color

over10.q: I weaken all men for hours each day. I show you strange visions while you are away. I take you by night, by day take you back. None suffer to have me, but do from my lack.
over10.hint: Rest that brings dreams; weakens but is needed

over10.q: A mile from end to end, yet as close to as a friend. A precious commodity, freely given. Seen on the dead and on the living. Found on the rich, poor, short and tall, but shared among children most of all.
over10.hint: A mile from end to end, freely given, seen on all

over10.q: A house full, a yard full, a chimney full, no one can get a spoonful.
over10.hint: Fills a house and chimney, can't be scooped up

over10.q: I can sizzle like bacon, I am made with an egg. I have plenty of backbone, but lack a good leg. I peel layers like onions, but still remain whole. I can be long, like a flagpole, yet fit in a hole.
over10.hint: Coiled, sheds its skin, has a backbone but no legs

over10.q: As beautiful as the setting sun, as delicate as the morning dew. An angel's dusting from the stars. That can turn the Earth into a frosted moon.
over10.hint: White, falls from the sky, melts in your hand

over10.q: High born, my touch is gentle. Purest white is my lace. Silence is my kingdom. Green is the color of my death.
over10.hint: Pure white, silent, dies on green grass

over10.q: White bird, featherless, flying out of paradise. Flying over sea and land. Dying in my hand.
over10.hint: White, featherless, flies from the sky

over10.q: I saw a man in white, he looked quite a sight. He was not old, but he stood in the cold. And when he felt the sun, he started to run. Who could he be? Please answer me.
over10.hint: A figure of snow that melts when the sun comes out

over10.q: They made me a mouth, but didn't give me breath. Water gives me life, but the sun brings me death.
over10.hint: Made of snow, lives with water, dies in the sun

over10.q: I cannot be felt, seen or touched. Yet I can be found in everybody. My existence is always in debate. Yet I have my own style of music.
over10.hint: The spiritual part of a person; a genre of music

over10.q: What surrounds the world, yet dwells within a thimble?
over10.hint: The vast void beyond the sky

over10.q: A horrid monster hides from the day, with many legs and many eyes. With silver chains it catches prey. And eats it all before it dies. Yet in every cottage does it stay. And every castle beneath the sky.
over10.hint: Many legs, spins webs, lives in cottages and castles

over10.q: I move without wings, Between silken string, I leave as you find, My substance behind.
over10.hint: Moves on silk threads, leaves a web behind

over10.q: I went to the woods and got it, when i got it didn’t want it, looked for it, couldn’t find it so I took it home.
over10.hint: A tiny sliver of wood stuck in your skin

over10.q: I'm full of holes, yet I'm full of water.
over10.hint: Full of holes yet soaks up water

over10.q: We travel much, yet prisoners are, and close confined to boot. Yet with any horse, we will keep the pace, and will always go on foot.
over10.hint: Metal studs on a rider's boot that keep pace with a horse

over10.q: A nut cracker up in a tree.
over10.hint: A small animal that stores nuts up in trees

over10.q: What has wings, but can not fly. Is enclosed, but can outside also lie. Can open itself up, or close itself away. Is the place of kings and queens and doggerel of every means. What is it upon which I stand? Which can lead us to different lands.
over10.hint: Where actors perform; opens and closes; the place of kings

over10.q: Upon me you can tread, though softly under cover. And I will take you places, that you have yet to discover. I'm high, and I'm low, though flat in the middle. And though a joy to the children, adults think of me little.
over10.hint: Steps that go up and down, high and low

over10.q: What goes around the world and stays in a corner?
over10.hint: Adhesive paper for mail that goes around the world

over10.q: With pointed fangs it sits in wait. With piercing force it doles out fate, over bloodless victims proclaiming its might. Eternally joining in a single bite.
over10.hint: Joins paper with metal pins in a single bite

over10.q: At night I come without being fetched. By day I am lost without being stolen.
over10.hint: Dots of light visible at night, hidden by day

over10.q: We are all around, yet to us you are half blind. Sunlight makes us invisible, and difficult to find.
over10.hint: Scattered in the sky, invisible in sunlight

over10.q: The more you take, the more you leave behind.
over10.hint: The more you take, the more you leave behind

over10.q: Four of us are in your field, But our differences keep us at yield, First, a one that is no fool, Though he resembles a gardener’s tool, Next, one difficult to split in two, And a girl once had one as big as her shoe, Then, to the mind, one’s a lovely bonder, And truancy makes it grow fonder, Last, a stem connecting dots of three
over10.hint: A word puzzle about four things found in a field

over10.q: Inside a great blue castle lives a shy young maid. She blushes in the morning and comes not out at night.
over10.hint: A shy maiden who blushes in the morning, hidden at night

over10.q: My children are near and far. No matter that I know where they are. The gift I give them make their day. But if I were gone they would wander away.
over10.hint: Gives light and warmth; its children depend on it

over10.q: What goes through the door without pinching itself? What sits on the stove without burning itself? What sits on the table and is not ashamed?
over10.hint: Shines through windows, on stoves, and on tables

over10.q: I appear in the morning. But am always there. You can never see me. Though I am everywhere. By night I am gone, though I sometimes never was. Nothing can defeat me. But I am easily gone.
over10.hint: Appears in the morning, everywhere but invisible

over10.q: Sleeping during the day, I hide away. Watchful through the night, I open at dawn's light. But only for the briefest time, do I shine. And then I hide away. And sleep through the day.
over10.hint: Opens at dawn, shines briefly, then hides again

over10.q: A dragons tooth in a mortals hand, I kill, I maim, I divide the land.
over10.hint: A bladed weapon that kills and divides the land

over10.q: With sharp edged wit and pointed poise. It can settle disputes without making a noise.
over10.hint: Sharp-edged, settles disputes without a sound

over10.q: He has one and a person has two. A citizen has three. And a human being has four. A personality has five. And an inhabitant of earth has six.
over10.hint: A unit of pronunciation; one in 'he', two in 'person'

over10.q: What starts with a 'T', ends with a 'T', and has T in it?
over10.hint: Starts and ends with T, has a T inside

over10.q: You must keep this thing. Its loss will affect your brothers. For once yours is lost, it will soon be lost by others.
over10.hint: Losing it affects everyone around you

over10.q: What can't you see, hear or feel, until its too late. What shadows love, and shopkeepers hate?
over10.hint: Steals without being seen, heard, or felt

over10.q: An open ended barrel, it is shaped like a hive. It is filled with the flesh, and the flesh is alive.
over10.hint: A small metal cap for protecting a finger while sewing

over10.q: He stands beside the road. In a purple cap at tattered green cloak. Those who touch him, curse him.
over10.hint: A spiky purple flower with a green cloak

over10.q: I walked and walked and at last I got it. I didn't want it. So I stopped and looked for it. When I found it, I threw it away.
over10.hint: A sharp point on a plant; walked into and thrown away

over10.q: Soft and fragile is my skin, I get my growth in mud. I’m dangerous as much as pretty, for if not careful, I draw blood.
over10.hint: Soft and pretty but draws blood if you're careless

over10.q: Fatherless and motherless. Born without sin, roared when it came into the world. And never spoke again.
over10.hint: The loud sound after a lightning flash

over10.q: When the day after tomorrow is yesterday. Today will be as far from Wednesday. As today was from Wednesday. When the day before yesterday was tomorrow. What is the day after this day?
over10.hint: A day-of-the-week logic puzzle

over10.q: In we go, out we go. All around and in a row. Always, always steady flow. When we'll stop, you'll never known. In we go, out we go.
over10.hint: The steady in-and-out rhythm of the ocean

over10.q: There are two meanings to me. With one I may need to be broken, with the other I hold on. My favorite characteristic is my charming dimple.
over10.hint: Neckwear with a charming dimple; two meanings

over10.q: Mountains will crumble and temples will fall. And no man can survive its endless call.
over10.hint: The endless force that erodes mountains and kingdoms

over10.q: This thing all things devours: Birds, beasts, trees, flowers; Gnaws iron, bites steel; Grinds hard stones to meal; Slays king, ruins town, And beats high mountains down.
over10.hint: Devours all things: birds, stones, kings

over10.q: Until I am measured I am not known, Yet how you miss me when I have flown.
over10.hint: Unmeasured, you don't know it; once gone, you miss it

over10.q: What flies without wings? What passes all things? What mends all sorrow? What brings the morrow?
over10.hint: Flies without wings, brings the morrow

over10.q: What is it which builds things up? Lays mountains low? Dries up lakes, and makes things grow? Cares not a whim about your passing? And is like few other things, because it is everlasting?
over10.hint: Builds and destroys, everlasting, cares not about you

over10.q: I never was, am always to be. No one ever saw me, nor ever will. And yet I am the confidence of all, To live and breath on this terrestrial ball.
over10.hint: Always to come, never seen by anyone

over10.q: Forward I’m heavy, but backwards I’m not.
over10.hint: A unit of weight that's heavy forward, light backwards

over10.q: Often held but never touched. Always wet but never rusts. Often bits but seldom bit. To use it well you must have wit.
over10.hint: Held in the mouth, wet, and bites

over10.q: Blend a teapot shot so the pearlies won’t rot!
over10.hint: A teapot shot (tub) to keep the pearlies (teeth) from rotting

over10.q: What gets wetter as it dries?
over10.hint: Gets wetter the more it dries

over10.q: Dies half its life. Lives the rest. Dances without music. Breathes without breath.
over10.hint: Loses leaves in winter, regrows in spring; breathes without breath

over10.q: I am mother and father, but never birth or nurse. I'm rarely still, but I never wander.
over10.hint: Mother and father of birds and squirrels

over10.q: Reaching stiffly for the sky, I bare my fingers when its cold. In warmth I wear an emerald glove and in between I dress in gold.
over10.hint: Bare in winter, green in summer, gold in between

over10.q: Some live in me, some live on. And some shave me to stride upon. I rarely leave my native land. Until my death I always stand. High and low I may be found. Both above and below ground.
over10.hint: Many live on and in it; stands for a very long time

over10.q: Who is it that rows quickly with four oars, but never comes out from under his own roof?
over10.hint: An animal with a shell on its back, rows with four flippers

over10.q: What goes up when the rain comes down?
over10.hint: Opens up when the rain comes down

over10.q: My voice is tender, my waist is slender and I'm often invited to play. Yet wherever I go, I must take my bow or else I have nothing to say.
over10.hint: A string instrument played with a bow

over10.q: What instrument can make any sound and be heart, but not touched or seen?
over10.hint: You can hear it but not see or touch it

over10.q: My thunder comes before the lightning. My lightning comes before the clouds. My rain dries all the land it touches.
over10.hint: A mountain that erupts with fire, ash, and rain that dries the land

over10.q: We are five little objects of an everyday sort. You will find us all in a tennis court.
over10.hint: Five letters all found in 'tennis court'

over10.q: I run around the city, but I never move.
over10.hint: A barrier that surrounds a city but never moves

over10.q: As soft as silk, as white as milk, as bitter as gall, a thick green wall, and a green coat covers me all.
over10.hint: A nut with a thick green husk and bitter meat

over10.q: A harvest sown and reaped on the same day in an unplowed field. Which increases without growing, remains whole though it is eaten within and without. Is useless and yet the staple of nations.
over10.hint: Conflict that grows without physical growth, sown and reaped the same day

over10.q: It is a part of us, and then replaced. It escapes out bodies, to a better place. The world becomes its sizeable home. Its passions unrestraint, the planet it roams.
over10.hint: A part of our body that constantly cycles out and in

over10.q: Runs smoother than any rhyme, loves to fall but cannot climb!
over10.hint: Flows and falls, never climbs; smoother than a rhyme

over10.q: Three lives have I. Gentle enough to soothe the skin. Light enough to caress the sky. Hard enough to crack rocks.
over10.hint: Three states: soothes, caresses, cracks rocks

over10.q: The moon is my father. The sea is my mother. I have a million brothers. I die when I reach land.
over10.hint: Created by the moon's pull on the sea; dies on land

over10.q: My first is in wield, sever bones and marrow. My second is in blade, forged in cold steel. My third is an arbalest, and also in arrows. My fourth is in power, plunged through a shield. My fifth is in honor, and also in vows. My last will put an end to it all.
over10.hint: Build it from letters in 'wield', 'blade', 'arrow', 'honor'

over10.q: As round as an apple. As deep as a cup. All the king's horses can't pull it up.
over10.hint: Deep, round, and full of water; horses can't pull it up

over10.q: I go around in circles, but always straight ahead. Never complain, no matter where I am led.
over10.hint: Goes in circles but always travels straight ahead

over10.q: A leathery snake, with a stinging bite. I'll stay coiled up, unless I must fight.
over10.hint: A coiled leather strip that cracks with a stinging bite

over10.q: All about, but cannot be seen, Can be captured, cannot be held, No throat, but can be heard.
over10.hint: An invisible force you can hear but not hold

over10.q: I pass before the sun, but make no shadow.
over10.hint: Passes before the sun without casting a shadow

over10.q: Voiceless it cries,Voiceless it cries, Wingless flutters, Toothless bites, Mouthless mutters.
over10.hint: Cries without a voice, flutters without wings, bites without teeth

over10.q: What flies forever, Rests never?
over10.hint: Flies forever without ever resting

over10.q: I have four wings but cannot fly. I never laugh and never cry. On the same spot always found, toiling away with little sound.
over10.hint: Four blades that turn in the wind, always in the same spot

over10.q: There is an ancient invention. Still used in some parts of the world today. That allows people to see through walls.
over10.hint: A glass panel in a wall; an ancient invention

over10.q: When young, I am sweet in the sun. When middle-aged, I make you gay. When old, I am valued more than ever.
over10.hint: Aged grape drink; sweet when young, valued when old

over10.q: I am the heart that does not beat. If cut, I bleed without blood. I can fly, but have no wings. I can float, but have no fins. I can sing, but have no mouth.
over10.hint: The heart of a tree; floats, bleeds sap, sings in the fire

over10.q: What is it that you must give before you can keep it.
over10.hint: A promise you give before you can keep it

over10.q: What does no man want, yet no man want to lose?
over10.hint: A state no one wants, yet no one wants to lose

over10.q: What must be in the oven yet can not be baked? Grows in the heat yet shuns the light of day? What sinks in water but rises with air? Looks like skin but is fine as hair?
over10.hint: A microorganism that makes bread rise; sinks in water, rises with air
